Kiran Thakur
QA Automation Engineer | Ahmedabad
kiran.thakur746@example.com | +91 9192495905

Versatile QA Automation Engineer with a background in technical recruitment. Experience building and maintaining automated test suites, improving release quality, and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Strong foundation in manual and automated testing, with prior experience in full-cycle recruitment and talent acquisition.

Experience
Infosys — Aug 2025 - Present
QA Automation Engineer (Onsite/Remote)
- Developed and maintained Selenium-based automated test suites in Java, increasing regression coverage by 42% and reducing manual regression time by 60%.
- Integrated JUnit test runners with CI pipelines and reported failures through Jira, reducing build-to-release cycle defects by 30%.
- Designed API smoke tests using Postman and automated their execution in nightly runs; surfaced 12 critical API issues across services.
- Collaborated with Agile teams to triage defects and improve test stability on Linux test agents, reducing flaky test rate by 25%.

Zoho — Apr 2024 - Jul 2025
Recruiter (Onsite/Remote)
- Managed end-to-end Recruitment lifecycle for engineering roles, sourcing and screening 300+ candidates and closing 48 hires across product and QA teams.
- Implemented talent outreach strategies that improved candidate response rates by 35% and reduced average time-to-fill by 18 days.
- Partnered with hiring managers and hiring committees, using metrics tracked in Jira and ATS to prioritize hiring needs and forecast hiring velocity.
- Conducted technical screenings and coordinated interview loops in Agile hiring sprints, improving offer acceptance by focusing on role fit and candidate experience.

Projects
- Internal Test Dashboard: Built a dashboard aggregating Selenium and JUnit results with Jira links, enabling product owners to see release health at a glance and cut investigation time by 20%.
- Candidate Pipeline Tracker: Created a lightweight pipeline tracker integrating ATS exports and manual notes to optimize Talent Acquisition workflows and weekly hiring reports.

Languages: Java
